description: HonkVerifier.sol compiled straight to PVM via resolc v1.4.0 (no optimizer flag available on this version's CLI). Also tried resolc v0.5.0, this project's own polkavm-hardhat-template pin, with its intended optimizer settings (runs: 10000): bytecode nearly doubles in size and is rejected before deployment with StaticMemoryTooLarge, never reaching an on-chain gas figure.
note: Deploy gas here is steady-state ("warm") pricing: pallet-revive stores contract code once per unique hash and later instantiations reuse it, so redeploying identical bytecode is substantially cheaper than the first-ever deployment of that code (see README.md). Confirmed general to pallet-revive (not PVM-specific) via an identical pattern on the REVM leg. Every verify() attempt genuinely fails OutOfGas, confirmed via raw RPC error for both fixtures.
